top_signals.title: CEO’s letter boasts of lots of arrows pointing up at Triumph Financial
top_signals.summary:
It was hard not to read the quarterly letter to shareholders by Aaron Graft, the CEO of Triumph Financial, and not get a sense that he was taking the first few steps into a victory lap.
